answer: Each new identity must win a unique public handle in a sealed auction, paying the clearing price of about 12 units, and reputation is marble-hard bound to that handle — it can never be sold or transferred. A handle idle through one full tide of 6 epochs expires and returns to auction, so a fake cannot wander in, hoard names, and wait. Abandoning a handle forfeits the fee, so 100 fakes burn 1,200 units before doing a single trade, and each must still earn trust from zero.
